zh: 滙豐客戶可透過RedCoin認購代幣化基金
應用由日常支付擴展至財富管理範疇
基金入場門檻為港幣100元
work.en: HSBC customers in Hong Kong can now use the bank's RedCoin stablecoin to subscribe to an Ethereum-based tokenised money market fund via the HSBC HK Mobile Banking App. The move expands the stablecoin's use cases from everyday payments into wealth management, featuring an entry threshold of HKD 100.
work.title: HSBC Links RedCoin Wallets to Its Tokenised Money Market Fund

zh: 立法會通過修訂《銀行業條例草案》
香港銀行體系簡化為「兩級制」
修訂涵蓋銀行控股公司等五個範疇
work.en: The Legislative Council passed a bill on 18 November to amend Hong Kong's Banking Ordinance, simplifying the city's banking structure into a two-tier system. The amendments cover five key areas, including rules for bank holding companies, bringing local regulatory frameworks closer to international financial centers.
work.title: Hong Kong Simplifies Its Banking System to Two Tiers

zh: 渣打完成跨行代幣化美元支付測試
交易可在數分鐘之內完成結算
進一步提升跨行資金轉算效率
work.en: Standard Chartered has completed testing for cross-bank tokenised US dollar payments that settle within minutes. The milestone demonstrates enhanced speed and efficiency for interbank digital asset transactions.
work.title: BANKING

zh: 研究指亞太區28%銀行客戶對主行滿意度低
當中23%感到稍微滿意，5%表示不滿意
高達25%客戶正考慮更換主要開戶銀行
work.en: Research by Celent and Temenos shows that 28% of APAC bank customers are slightly satisfied (23%) or not satisfied at all (5%) with their primary bank. Consequently, 1 in 4 banking customers across the region are ready to switch providers.
work.title: 1 in 4 APAC Bank Customers Are Ready to Switch. Here’s How to Stop Them

zh: Ant與星展及富蘭克林鄧普頓開展合作
推出Whale協議自動切換代幣化存款與MMF
項目屬新加坡Project BLOOM旗下試點
work.en: Ant International has launched its Whale Orchestration Protocol to automate switching between tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds (tMMFs). Developed under Singapore's Project BLOOM in collaboration with DBS Bank and Franklin Templeton, the initiative has successfully completed initial pilots.
work.title: Ant International, DBS, Franklin Templeton automate tokenized deposit to MMF switching

smalltalk_hk.headline: Palo Alto Networks Reports Strong Q1 and Proposes $4.5B Acquisition
smalltalk_hk.body: Palo Alto Networks posted first-quarter earnings that beat market expectations. The company also announced a $4.5 billion acquisition of Applied Compute.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Kofu Medical Acquires 60% Stake in Oxygen Concentrator Maker
smalltalk_hk.body: Kofu Medical (01187) is acquiring a 60% stake in oxygen concentrator manufacturer Kangjuren Medical Devices for RMB 99.48 million.
smalltalk_hk.title: 可孚醫療(01187)斥9948萬人幣，收購製氧機產銷商康居人醫療器械60%股權

smalltalk_hk.headline: Kuaishou Q3 Adjusted Net Profit Down 84%
smalltalk_hk.body: Kuaishou reported an 84% year-on-year drop in Q3 adjusted net profit to RMB 790 million. Meanwhile, its R&D expenditure increased by 42% to RMB 5.178 billion.
smalltalk_hk.title: 【1024業績】快手經調整純利按年跌84%至7.9億元人幣 研發開支增42%至51.78億元

smalltalk_hk.headline: Baidu Fined RMB 500k Over Illegal Acquisition of YY Segment
smalltalk_hk.body: China's SAMR fined Baidu Hong Kong RMB 500,000 for illegal concentration of undertakings regarding its acquisition of part of Joyy's business.
smalltalk_hk.title: 《中國監管》市監總局：百度香港收購歡聚集團部分業務違法，罰款50萬人幣

smalltalk_hk.headline: Primary One Discretionary Places Results Out Next Monday
smalltalk_hk.body: The Education Bureau announced that Primary One discretionary place results for September 2027 will be released next Monday. Out of 32,104 applicants for government and aided primary schools, 18,148 will be offered a place.
smalltalk_hk.title: P1 school results drop next Mon

smalltalk_sg.headline: Police Probe Unregulated Consultancy for Loan Fraud
smalltalk_sg.body: Singapore Police are investigating an unregulated loan consultancy for allegedly helping vulnerable clients inflate income and alter tax documents to secure bank loans.
smalltalk_sg.title: SPF: Police probe unregulated loan consultancy that allegedly advised clients to inflate income and alter tax notices to get bank loans

smalltalk_sg.headline: MAS Directs Users Not to Share Bank Logins with AI Agents
smalltalk_sg.body: The Monetary Authority of Singapore warned users against providing banking credentials to AI agents. It noted that no date has been set for 'Know Your Agent' frameworks.

smalltalk_sg.headline: MAS Pledges S$100 Million to Boost AI and Quantum Tech
smalltalk_sg.body: The Singapore financial sector will receive up to S$100 million in MAS grants to accelerate AI and quantum computing capabilities.
